The company has its registered office in Kolkata and head office in Mumbai with presence in twenty-five cities across three countries.{{cite web|title=About us|publisher=Official website|accessdate=18 February 2017|url=http://www.speciality.co.in/speciality.php}}{{cite web|title=Annual report 14-15|publisher=Official website|accessdate=18 February 2017|url=http://www.speciality.co.in/pdf/annual_report/Speciality_Restaurants_Annual_Report_2014-15.pdf}} Speciality Restaurants Limited is listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] stock exchanges of India.{{cite web|title=BSE page|publisher=[[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] website|accessdate=18 February 2017|url=http://www.bseindia.com/stock-share-price/speciality-restaurants-ltd/speciality/534425/}}{{cite web|title=NSE website|publisher=[[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] website|accessdate=18 February 2017|url=http://www.nseindia.com/live_market/dynaContent/live_watch/get_quote/GetQuote.jsp?symbol=SPECIALITY&illiquid=0&smeFlag=0&itpFlag=0}} ==History== Speciality Restaurants Limited was started in 1992 by [[Anjan Chatterjee]]. The company's first restaurant was started in 1992 in Mumbai and was called "Only Fish". In 1994, the company started two new brands "Oh! Calcutta" and "Mainland China" (both in Mumbai). The first outlet of Mainland China was started in [[Saki Naka]]. In 2012, the company got listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]] stock exchanges of India.{{cite web|title=History|publisher=Official website|accessdate=18 February 2017|url=http://www.speciality.co.in/our_story.php}} ==Restaurants and brands== [[File:Hoppipola logo.jpg|thumb|Hoppipola logo at its outlet in [[Galleria, Powai|Galleria]]]] Speciality Restaurants Limited owns and operates the following chains of restaurants and brands across multiple locations:{{Cite web|url=https://www.bseindia.com/bseplus/AnnualReport/534425/5344250319.pdf|title=Speciality Restaurants Ltd. extract: Speciality Restaurants Limited is an Indian restaurant company that owns multiple chains of fine and casual dining restaurants in India, Bangladesh and Tanzania. Speciality Restaurants Limited also owns and operates confectionery stores. The company has its registered office in Kolkata and head office in Mumbai with presence in twenty-five cities across three countries. Speciality Restaurants Limited is listed on BSE and NSE stock exchanges of India.
